bloodPressure.title: Blood Pressure Log
bloodPressure.description: Record and classify your blood pressure. Records are stored in your browser.

measurement.title: Measurement Tips
items: Rest for at least 5 minutes before measuring
Measure at elbow height in a comfortable position
Measure regularly at the same time of day
Avoid caffeine and exercise 30 min before

tips.title: Health Management
items: Recommended: Measure daily at same time
Consult doctor for repeated abnormal readings
This log is for reference only, not medical diagnosis

whatIs.title: What is the Blood Pressure Logger?
whatIs.description: The Blood Pressure Logger is a health tracking tool that lets you record daily systolic (upper) and diastolic (lower) blood pressure readings and pulse, then visualize trends over time. It classifies readings according to WHO and Korean Society of Hypertension guidelines. All data is stored locally in your browser — no sign-up required.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Measure your blood pressure with a home monitor and enter the systolic and diastolic values.
2. Optionally enter the measurement time and pulse rate.
3. Click Save to add the entry and see the blood pressure classification.
4. Review the trend chart and refer to the average values for your health monitoring.

items.q: Will my data be lost if I clear the browser cache?
items.a: Yes — data is stored in browser localStorage. Clearing your cache or using incognito mode will erase it. We recommend exporting to CSV regularly as a backup.

items.q: What is the normal blood pressure range?
items.a: Normal is below 120/80 mmHg. Elevated is 120–129/below 80. Stage 1 hypertension is 130–139/80–89. Stage 2 hypertension is 140/90 or higher.

items.q: Can I use this for medical diagnosis?
items.a: No. This tool is for personal reference only. If you consistently see abnormal readings, please consult a doctor.
